description: Business object representing a single process activity in the ProcessActivityTimeline widget

properties.name: activityName
properties.description: Alternative property for activity name (alias for name)

properties.name: startTime
properties.description: Start time of the activity as a Date object

properties.name: endTime
properties.description: End time of the activity as a Date object

properties.name: status
properties.description: Activity status: completed, active, pending, failed, skipped, waiting

properties.name: assignee
properties.description: User or system assigned to the activity

properties.name: assigneeAvatarImage
properties.description: Base64 avatar image or data URI for the assignee profile icon

properties.name: assigneeAvatarFormat
properties.description: Image format for the assignee avatar, such as png

properties.name: duration
properties.description: Duration of the activity in milliseconds
